questions: Can Takahashi move through walkways to floors that don't exist in the target building? For example, if he's on floor 5 in building (i,j) and building (i+1,j) only has 3 floors, can he move to floor 5 of building (i+1,j) via walkway?
Is the movement cost for using stairs always exactly 1 per floor moved, regardless of direction (up or down)?
Can Takahashi move multiple floors within a building using stairs in a single operation, or must he move exactly one floor at a time?
If Takahashi is on floor X and wants to move to floor Y in the same building, can he use walkways to other buildings and return to achieve fewer stair uses than |X-Y|?
Are walkways bidirectional? That is, if he can move from building A to building B on floor X, can he also move from building B to building A on floor X?
Can Takahashi use walkways between buildings that have different maximum floors, provided the specific floor X exists in both?
Is there any cost associated with using walkways, or are they free?
Can Takahashi move directly between non-adjacent buildings via walkways in a single move, or must he move only to cardinally adjacent blocks?
